sn1.33:10.3: This river is described at [snp3.10:26.1](). It features in the later literature of the Brahmins (eg. Bhāgavata Purāṇa 5.26.22, Skanda Purāṇa 6.1.226.32) and Jains (Sūtrakṛtāṅga 1.5.1.8).
sn1.33:16.2: Both PTS and BJT have the singular _karoti_ here.
sn1.33:19.4: The lesson of this verse is that study of “passages of teaching” (_dhammapada_) stimulates wisdom leading to liberation.
